Teenager scales mobile tower demanding boyfriend's release

A 17-year-old girl in Jharkhand climbed a 100-foot mobile tower, threatening to jump. Her demand was for the release of her boyfriend from jail. The incident drew attention to the unusual nature of the protest and the underlying situation.
